questions.q: "'Return to me,' says the LORD of Armies, '____,' says the LORD of Armies."
questions.answer: and I will return to you
wrong: and I will heal your land

questions.q: In Zechariah's night vision, what was the man riding?
The riders reported that all the earth was at rest and in peace.
Where was the man standing in the vision?
options: Among the myrtle trees in a ravine

questions.q: What did the LORD's angel ask the LORD of Armies?
options: How long until he would have mercy on Jerusalem
Why the nations were at peace
When the temple would be finished

questions.q: "I am jealous for Jerusalem and for Zion ____."
What had the former prophets told their fathers?
options: Return from your evil ways and doings
Build the house of the LORD
Flee from the land of the north

questions.q: God said he was only a little displeased with the nations that were at ease.
What did the LORD show Zechariah after the four horns?

What did the angel say the horns Zechariah saw had done?

options: Go back and forth through the earth

What did Zechariah see the man holding in his hand?

options: Because of the multitude of men and livestock
Because its walls had been torn down

questions.q: "He who touches you touches ____."

What will the LORD inherit as his portion in the holy land?

What will happen when God shakes his hand over the nations that plundered Zion?
options: They will be plunder to those who served them
They will be scattered to the four winds
They will bring gifts to Zion
They will turn and fight each other

questions.q: What did the man in the vision say he was going out to measure?
options: The width and length of Jerusalem

questions.q: Zion is told to escape from dwelling with whom?
For I have spread you abroad as ____, says the LORD.
questions.answer: the four winds of the sky

questions.q: The other angel was told to run and speak to an old man about Jerusalem's future.
For what does the speaker say he has been sent to the nations which plundered Zion?
Who went out to meet the angel who talked with Zechariah?
options: A rider on a red horse

"Isn't this ____ plucked out of the fire?"

"Behold, I have caused ____ to pass from you, and I will clothe you with rich clothing."
How many eyes were on the stone set before Joshua?

What did God say he would remove in one day?
What did the LORD say to Satan?
How does the LORD describe the fellows who sit before Joshua?
Behold, the stone that I have set before Joshua ... I will ____, says the LORD of Armies.
The LORD's angel solemnly assured Zechariah, not Joshua, of the LORD's promise.
"'Not by might, nor by power, but ____,' says the LORD of Armies."
What did Zechariah see in this vision?
options: A golden lamp stand with two olive trees
A man with a measuring line

questions.q: Zerubbabel's hands laid the foundation of the house, and his hands would finish it.
How did the angel come to Zechariah this time?
options: He woke him like a man wakened from sleep
He called to him from a whirlwind

questions.q: "He will bring out the capstone with shouts of '____!'"

options: It will be cast into the sea

questions.q: When the angel asked if he knew what these were, Zechariah said yes.
"Indeed, who despises ____?"
What did the angel say the seven were?
options: The LORD's eyes, running through the whole earth
The seven spirits of the prophets

questions.q: Who did the angel say the two olive trees were?
options: Two anointed ones who stand by the Lord of the earth
Two prophets sent to the nations
The kings of Israel and Judah

questions.q: To whom was the LORD's word "Not by might, nor by power" given?
What will the seven see in the hand of Zerubbabel?
When Zechariah asked "What are these, my lord?", how did the angel first reply?
Zechariah described two golden spouts that pour golden oil out of themselves.
What did Zechariah see flying?
What was sitting in the middle of the ephah basket?
The flying scroll was the curse going out over the whole land.
Which two kinds of people would the curse of the scroll cut off?
options: Those who steal and those who swear falsely
Those who oppress widows and orphans

questions.q: "It will remain in the middle of his house, and will destroy it with ____."
What did the angel call what was inside the ephah basket?
The angel closed the ephah basket by throwing ____ on its mouth.
The two women who lifted the basket had wings like the wings of an eagle.
Where was the ephah basket being carried?
options: To the depths of the sea

questions.q: The two women lifted up the ephah basket ____.
Why was the ephah basket with the woman being carried away?
options: To throw her into the sea
To bury her in the desert

questions.q: How long was the flying scroll?
Zechariah asked the angel where the women were carrying the ephah basket.
The angel who talked with me came forward and said to me, "Lift up now your eyes and ____ that is appearing."

On whose head was Zechariah told to set the crowns?
The angel said the chariots were the four winds of the sky.
Which chariot had the red horses?
"Behold, the man whose name is ____! He will grow up out of his place."
Which way did the chariot with the black horses go?
What were the crowns made from?

The promise that those far off would come and build the temple had no condition attached.
"Those who go toward the north country have ____ in the north country."
What will the man who grows up out of his place build?
What color were the horses of the fourth chariot?
Where were the crowns to be kept as a memorial?
The strong horses were told, "Go around and through the earth!"
He will bear the glory, and will ____ on his throne.
What question did the men ask the priests and prophets?
options: Should they keep weeping in the fifth month?
When would the temple be finished?
Should they go back to Babylon?

questions.q: "Execute true judgment, and show ____ every man to his brother."
The people refused to listen, turned their backs, and stopped their ears.
Which town's people sent men to entreat the LORD's favor?
What did God ask about their fasting in the fifth and seventh months?
options: Did you really fast to me?
Why did you fast only once a year?

questions.q: "Yes, they made ____, lest they might hear the law."
questions.answer: their hearts as hard as flint
wrong: their necks as stiff as iron

questions.q: What were they told not to devise in their hearts?
How did God say he would scatter them among the nations?
"Thus the land was desolate after them... for they made ____ desolate."
The LORD said that even though they refused to listen, he would still listen when they called.
Whom were the people told not to oppress?
options: The widow, the fatherless, the foreigner, and the poor

questions.q: What did the LORD say about the people's eating and drinking?
options: They ate and drank for themselves
They ate food that was unclean
They drank wine on fast days
They refused to share their bread

questions.q: Aren't these the words which the LORD proclaimed by the former prophets when Jerusalem was inhabited and ____?

Through whom had the LORD of Armies sent the law and his words by his Spirit?
What will Jerusalem be called when the LORD returns to Zion?
What will fill the streets of the city?
Old men and old women will again dwell in Jerusalem's streets with staffs in their hands.
"Speak every man ____ with his neighbor. Execute the judgment of truth and peace in your gates."
What would the fasts of the fourth, fifth, seventh, and tenth months become?
"As you were a curse among the nations, so I will save you, and ____."
God said he would save his people from the north country and the south country.
What will men from the nations say as they take hold of a Jew's robe?
options: We will go with you, for God is with you
Teach us the law of Moses
Show us the temple of the LORD

questions.q: "The ground will give its increase, and the heavens will give ____."
Besides devising evil against a neighbor, what did the LORD say he hates?
What will the mountain of the LORD of Armies be called?
What was lacking before the foundation of the LORD's house was laid?
options: Wages for man and for animal

questions.q: ____, you who hear in these days these words from the mouth of the prophets.
The LORD says many peoples and strong nations will come to seek him in Babylon.
How many men out of all the languages of the nations will take hold of a Jew's skirt?
The inhabitants of one will go to another, saying, "Let's go speedily ____ of the LORD, and to seek the LORD of Armies."
What does the LORD ask about what seems marvelous to the remnant in those days?
options: Should it also be marvelous in my eyes?
Why do you doubt my word?
Who has seen such a thing?
Is anything too hard for the LORD?

questions.q: How is the coming King described?
options: Righteous, lowly, and riding on a donkey
Mighty and riding a war horse

questions.q: What will the King speak to the nations?
Ashkelon, Gaza, and Ekron would see what happened to Tyre and be afraid.
"Turn to the stronghold, ____! Even today I declare that I will restore double to you."
What will be cut off from Ephraim and Jerusalem?
options: The chariot, the horse, and the battle bow

questions.q: Tyre heaped up silver like the dust, and fine gold ____.
questions.answer: like the mire of the streets
wrong: like the sand of the sea

questions.q: Tyre's power in the sea would protect her from being devoured by fire.
Why did God set the prisoners free from the pit with no water?
options: Because of the blood of your covenant
Because they cried out day and night
Because the seventy years had ended

questions.q: "For indeed I bend Judah as ____ for me."

What are the people told to ask of the LORD?
The people wander like sheep and are oppressed because there is no shepherd.
From which two lands will God bring his people back?
"For the teraphim have spoken vanity, and ____."
questions.answer: the diviners have seen a lie
wrong: the elders have lost their way

questions.q: According to the chapter, what will come from Judah?
options: The cornerstone, the tent peg, and the battle bow
The altar, the lamp stand, and the ark
The scepter, the crown, and the throne
The shepherd, the staff, and the rod

questions.q: What will the LORD make the house of Judah like in battle?
"I will ____ and gather them, for I have redeemed them."
God said there would be plenty of room for the returning people in Gilead and Lebanon.
"I will sow them among the peoples. They will ____ in far countries."
What will happen to all the depths of the Nile?
How much did they weigh out for the shepherd's wages?
What names did the shepherd give his two staffs?
The LORD told him to throw the silver to the potter in the LORD's house.
Why did the shepherd cut apart his first staff?
options: To break his covenant with all the peoples
To show that the flock had been sold
To end the brotherhood of Judah and Israel

questions.q: "The LORD my God says: '____.'"
What did those who sold the flock say?
options: Blessed be the LORD, for I am rich
The LORD does not see us

questions.q: Lebanon is told to shut its doors so that the fire cannot devour its cedars.
"Throw it to the potter, ____ that I was valued at by them!"
"Woe to the worthless shepherd ____! The sword will strike his arm and his right eye."
What will the foolish shepherd do instead of caring for the flock?
options: Eat the meat of the fat sheep

questions.q: What will God make Jerusalem to all the surrounding peoples?
There would be a great mourning in Jerusalem in that day.
"They will look to me ____; and they shall mourn for him as one mourns for his only son."
What else will Jerusalem be for all the peoples?
What will the chieftains of Judah be like in that day?
options: A pan of fire among wood

questions.q: "I will pour on David's house and on the inhabitants of Jerusalem the spirit of ____."
The LORD will save Jerusalem first, before the tents of Judah.
Who will the feeble among Jerusalem's inhabitants be like in that day?
The mourning will be like the mourning of Hadadrimmon in which valley?
How will the families of the land mourn?
options: Each family apart, and their wives apart
All together in the temple court

questions.q: What will be opened to David's house and Jerusalem for sin and uncleanness?

God said he would cut off the names of the idols from the land.
What will a false prophet say he is instead of a prophet?

options: You must go to the priest

questions.q: In that day the prophets would proudly wear a hairy mantle.
Asked about his wounds, he will answer, "Those with which I was wounded in ____."
What will God do with the third part left in the land?
options: Refine them in the fire like silver
Scatter them to the four winds

questions.q: "I will say, 'It is my people;' and they will say, '____.'"
On which mountain will the LORD's feet stand in that day?
"The LORD will be ____. In that day the LORD will be one, and his name one."
Living waters will go out from Jerusalem in that day.
What will happen to the mountain where the LORD's feet stand?
options: It will split in two, making a great valley
It will be leveled into a plain
It will be raised above the hills

questions.q: What feast will survivors from the nations go up each year to keep?
What will happen to families of the earth that don't go up to worship the King?
options: They will be struck with blindness

questions.q: "Not day, and not night; but it will come to pass that ____ there will be light."
The people would flee as they fled from the earthquake in the days of King Hezekiah.
"In that day there will be inscribed on ____, 'HOLY TO THE LORD.'"
